affected_closure.label: Operational launch should remain gated until a reviewer records an explicit decision on completed diligence.

Immediate launch reduces reversibility because it converts a learn-first decision into an operational commitment under uncertainty.
Both lenses favor reversible diligence now and block launch pending resolved evidence plus an explicit gate decision.
